title: SMARTerV4 Amplification
author: Allen Institute
materials: SMARTerV4 (0.5x) Amplification for single-cell or single-nuclei RNASeq
First Strand DNA Synthesis and cDNA Amplification

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Equipment
steps.instruction: Set up the Pre-Amp ice pan and cooling blocks to maintain sample and reagent temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Fill a Pre-Amp ice pan with wet ice.
Place a GeneMate 96-well aluminum cooler block for samples, one for reagent aliquoting, and a GeneMate minifuge tube block on the ice; allow to cool for 5 minutes.
Place an additional GeneMate 96-well aluminum cooler block at room temperature inside the hood.

steps.title: Retrieve and Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Retrieve sample strips from -80 ºC and prepare them for processing.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve sample strips from -80 ºC and place them in order on the pre-cooled GeneMate 96-well aluminum cooler block in the wet ice pan.
For PatchSeq: Use two aluminum cooler blocks with 3D printed tube holders, leaving an empty column between sample columns.
Spin down sample strips (two at a time) in the Pre-Amp minifuge for 10 seconds, then return to the ice pan.
For PatchSeq: Transfer samples with 3D printed holders to a GeneMate 96-well PCR storage rack and spin down at 1000 x g using a PRE-AMP swing-bucket plate centrifuge.
Verify strip IDs with a witness against the paperwork.
Ensure correct orientation: Strip ID in 'A' position, buffer type/date in 'G', and FACS date in 'H'.
Label the neck of the H-well tube with the column number (use different color markers for different plates/sets).
For PatchSeq: Label the cap of each 0.2 mL tube with the well position; transfer controls to a reagent 8-strip (USA Scientific 1402-4700) if not already in one.

steps.title: Prepare and Dilute CDS Primer
steps.instruction: Thaw and dilute the 3' SMART-Seq CDS Primer II A to the working concentration.

substeps.instruction: Thaw SMART-Seq sc TSO (ST2196) or SMART-Seq v4 Oligonucleotide (48 μM) (ST0944), 3' SMART-Seq CDS Primer II A (12 μM) (ST2197 or ST0947), SMART-Seq sc First Strand Buffer (5X) (ST2199) or 5X Ultra Low First-Strand Buffer (ST0946), and Elution Buffer (ST2204 or ST0770) at room temperature.
Place PCR Primer II A (ST2200 or ST0945) in a blue cooling block at 4 ºC.
Gently pulse vortex (Setting 9 for 10s) the 3’ SMART-Seq CDS Primer II A and spin down in the Pre-Amp minifuge.
Dilute the primer from 12 μM to 6 μM by adding 220 μL NFdH20 to the 220 μL stock of 3' SMART-Seq CDS Primer II A.
Label the tube with 'D' and the 4-digit kit number, mark with a black stripe, cap, vortex, and spin down.
Aliquot 16 μL of the 6 μM primer into each well of a reagent 8-strip (USA Scientific 1402-4700) using a P20, then spin down and return to ice.
Store unused diluted primer and undiluted stock at -20 ºC.

steps.title: Add CDS Primer to Samples
steps.instruction: Distribute the diluted CDS primer into the sample tubes.

substeps.instruction: Move sample tubes one by one to the room temperature block to remove caps, then return the strip to the ice pan.
For PatchSeq: Open 0.2 mL tubes individually or by column using the 3D-printed opener.
Add 1 μL of 6 μM 3’ SMART-Seq CDS Primer II A to each well using an 8-channel P10, ensuring tips do not touch the sample.
Transfer strips one by one to the room temperature block and seal with the strip cap tool.
Vortex strips (Setting 9 for 10s) and spin down in the Pre-AMP hood minifuge.
For PatchSeq: Close tubes by hand, seal with the strip cap tool, and vortex using a GeneMate 96-well aluminum cooler block on top to prevent dislodging.
Return samples to the ice pan, load onto the block, and incubate for 3 minutes with the lid tightened.
Dispose of the reagent 8-strip.

steps.title: Prepare RT Master Mix
steps.instruction: Assemble the Reverse Transcription (RT) Master Mix on ice.

substeps.instruction: Vortex all reagents (Table 2) on setting 9 for 10s and spin down. Ensure 5x Ultra Low First-Strand Buffer is completely dissolved (repeat vortexing if precipitate remains).

In a 1.5 mL Eppendorf LoBind tube, add: 210 μL 5x Ultra Low First Strand Buffer (P1000), 52.5 μL SMART-Seq sc TSO (ST2196) or SMART-Seq V4 Oligonucleotide (48 µM) (ST0944) (P200), and 26.25 μL RNase Inhibitor (40 U/μL) (ST2195 or ST0764) (P200).
Vortex the mix (Setting 9 for 5s) and spin down.
Remove sample caps using the room temperature block method described previously.
Add 105 μL of SMARTScribe Reverse Transcriptase (100 U/μL) to the RT Master Mix (P200), vortex (Setting 9 for 10s), and spin down.
Aliquot 46.875 μL of the RT Master Mix into a reagent 8-strip (USA Scientific 1402-4700) using a P200.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Add the RT Master Mix to samples and initiate the reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 3.8 μL of RT Master Mix to each sample using an 8-channel P10, avoiding contact between tips and sample.
Seal strips using the room temperature block and strip cap tool.
Vortex (Setting 9 for 10s) and spin down in the Pre-AMP hood minifuge.
For PatchSeq: Close tubes by hand, seal with the strip cap tool, vortex with a cooler block on top, and spin down at 1000 x g in a PRE-AMP swing-bucket plate centrifuge.
Return samples to the ice pan.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the amplification mix approximately 20 minutes before RT completion.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve SeqAmp CB PCR Buffer (2x) (ST2193 or ST0665) and PCR Primer II A (12 μM) (ST2200 or ST0945) from storage and place on ice.
Vortex reagents (Setting 9 for 10s) and spin down.

In a 2 mL Eppendorf LoBind tube, add: 159 μL nuclease-free water (ST0804) (P1000), 1325 μL SeqAmp CB PCR Buffer (ST2193 or ST0665) (P1000), and 53 μL PCR Primer II A (12 µM) (ST2200 or ST0945) (P200).
Vortex (Setting 9 for 10s) and spin down.
Add 53 μL of SeqAMP DNA Polymerase (ST2192 or ST0784) (P200), vortex (Setting 9 for 10s), and spin down.
Aliquot 190 μL of the master mix into a new reagent 8-strip (USA Scientific 1402-4700) using a P200, then spin down.

steps.title: Perform cDNA Amplification
steps.instruction: Add PCR Master Mix to samples and run the thermocycler program.

substeps.instruction: Remove sample caps using the room temperature block method described previously.
Add 15 μL of PCR master mix to each sample using an 8-channel P20, using fresh tips for each strip and avoiding contact with the sample.
Seal strips using the room temperature block and strip cap tool.
Vortex (Setting 9 for 10s) and spin down in the Pre-AMP hood vortex and minifuge.
For PatchSeq: Close tubes by hand, seal with the strip cap tool, vortex with a cooler block on top, and spin down at 1000 x g in a PRE-AMP swing-bucket plate centrifuge.
Return samples to the ice pan.
Load strips into a thermocycler and run the protocol (Table 4), selecting the “S4 Half vol” folder for 0.5X PCR programs.
Immediately process strips through SPRI bead cleanup or store at 4 ºC for up to 24 hours.

steps.title: Prepare Cleanup Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare beads and buffers for the SPRI cleanup process.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate SeraMag beads (GE Healthcare 29343057) to room temperature for 30 minutes; vortex to mix.
Pipette required bead volume into a 25 mL divided reagent trough.
Add 25.0 µL of SeraMag Beads (0.9x volume) to each well of a 1 mL deep-well Nunc plate (VWR 73520-120) using an 8-channel E4-XLS+ (settings: 25 µL, 6 dispenses, speed 2).
Seal and spin down the bead plate (1000 x g for 15s) and label with the amplification ID.
Pour at least 6 mL of Elution Buffer (ST2204 or ST0770) into a 25 mL divided reagent trough, seal, label as 'Amplification EB', and spin down (1000 x g for 15s).

Prepare 80% Ethanol: Add 100% ABS grade Ethanol (AAPER E200G-P) and NFdH2O to a 500 mL reagent bottle (VWR 28199-760) according to paperwork (e.g., 34.4 mL EtOH and 8.6 mL water per plate). Label as '80% EtOH'.

Thaw 10X Lysis Buffer (Clontech 634892) to room temperature, pour into a 25 mL divided reservoir, and aliquot 50 µL into each well of an Eppendorf twin.tec 96-well PCR plate (VWR 47744-106) using an E4-XLS+ (settings: 50 µL, 4 aliquots, speed 5). Seal and centrifuge.

steps.title: Transfer cDNA to Cleanup Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer amplified cDNA from strips to a PCR plate for automated purification.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve 12 cDNA amplification strips from the thermocycler or 4 ºC refrigerator.
Label an Eppendorf twin.tec 96-well PCR plate (VWR 47744-106) with the amplification name.
With a witness, transfer the entire contents of PatchSeq tubes to the PCR plate using an 8-channel P200 @ 60 µL; recover remaining volume with a P20 if needed.
Seal and spin down the plate.
Add 0.5 µL of 10X Lysis Buffer to the strips or plate using a Post-AMP Integra or p2 8-channel pipette; initial the coversheet.

steps.title: Automated SPRI Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Use the Agilent Bravo robot to purify the amplified cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Load the amplified cDNA (strips or plate) onto the red metal Bravo 96-well block (A1 upper left, H12 lower right).
Verify strip placement by Strip Number (A01), Buffer Code (G01), and column ID on the H-well collar.
Open the 'Multi-Source SPRI protocol' in V-works (Production folder) and select the appropriate source plate (8 strip in Red Alum Insert).
Place the red Bravo plate on position 6 of the deck.
Enter source volume, bead volume, and elution recovery volume from the paperwork; set the number of columns to purify (e.g., 12).
Verify tip selection and deck layout on V-works; have a witness confirm all entries.
Initial the coversheet for 'Strip Order Witness', 'Bravo Deck Witness', date, and start time.
Run the program via the 'Run MultiSource SPRI Protocol' button (do not use the menu bar 'Run' button).
Switch tips as directed and reset tip boxes on the V-works form.
When prompted after the second Ethanol wash, replace the 80% EtOH trough with the Elution Buffer (EB) plate and press 'continue'.
Remove the Amplification Elution plate, seal, and spin down (1000 x g).
Visually confirm Elution Buffer presence in all wells; manually recover any missed volume from the bead plate using a magnet under witness.

steps.title: Final Aliquoting and Storage
steps.instruction: Aliquoting the purified cDNA for PicoGreen (PG) and FA plates.

substeps.instruction: Label a new Eppendorf twin.tec 96-well PCR plate with the 'PG_' plate name and a marker plate from 4 ºC with the amplification name (FA plate).
Place the amplification elution plate on the Post-AMP Integra in position 'AB' on an aluminum block and the PG plate in position 'B'.
Run the '3ul TWINTEK' program on the Integra.
Seal the PG plate and cover the elution plate; eject tips.
Load the FA plate in position 'B' and run the '1ul FA Plate' protocol.
Seal both the elution and FA plates.
Close the BRAVO and Post-AMP hoods and turn on UV lights.
Ensure all plates and aliquots are sealed and stored appropriately.
